question: Which among the following is the structural and fundamental unit of life?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cell.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The cell is the structural and fundamental unit of life as it is the smallest unit of life that can perform all the necessary functions of an organism.**
 
• Cells are responsible for carrying out all the processes necessary for life, such as** metabolism, growth, and reproduction.**
 
• There are two main types of cells:** prokaryotic cells,** which are simple cells without a nucleus, and** eukaryotic cells,** which are more complex cells with a nucleus and organelles.
 
• Cells are also able to communicate with each other through various** signaling pathways,** allowing for coordinated responses** **to changes in the environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tissue, enzyme, and hormone **are all important components of living organisms, but they are not the fundamental unit of life.
 
• **Tissues** are **groups of cells **that work together to perform a specific function.
 
 
• **Connective tissue, epithelial tissue, muscle tissue, and nervous tissue are the four fundamental types of tissue. **
 
 
 
• Enzymes are proteins that catalyze chemical reactions.
 
 
• **For many processes, including digestion and liver function, enzymes are crucial.**
 
• Health issues can result from having too much or too little of a specific enzyme.
 
• Healthcare professionals can also use the enzymes in our blood to check for** **injuries and illnesses.
 
 
 
• **Hormones are signaling molecules that regulate various physiological processes.**
 
 
• **Numerous bodily processes, including growth, repair, and reproduction, are regulated by hormones.**
 
• Numerous organ systems and hormones are part of the **endocrine system.**​
